title: Sales on a phone (salespeople in the field)

steps.do: Leads list, a lead, "Log a contact".
steps.expect: Usable without sideways scrolling of the page; buttons big enough to tap.
steps.observed: Leads list: width 390 px, page sideways scroll 0 px, every button at least 32 px | Lead: width 390 px, page sideways scroll 0 px, every button at least 32 px | Log a contact: width 390 px, page sideways scroll 0 px, every button at least 32 px, Save button 320×44 | saved: "Logged. Add the next step whenever you know it."

steps.do: Open a quotation and its PDF.
steps.observed: Quotation page: width 390 px, page sideways scroll 0 px, every button at least 32 px; the PDF downloads as a real PDF (6 kB).
steps.reason: Whether the PDF itself is readable on a phone screen is its printed look — a person has to open it once on a phone.

steps.do: New quote — the Line items tab.
steps.expect: Usable; record any field that cannot be reached.
steps.observed: Every line field (business unit, activity, service, description, site, order, qty, unit, rate) can be reached and typed; amount ₹10,000 shows; width 390 px, page sideways scroll 0 px, every button at least 32 px, wide tables: 1500px (scrolls inside itself).
